text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Right here, call out like, 'Excuse me, 
over here, please~'—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Playfully~ striking a pose, like this♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yup, our breathing was in perfect sync! We 
turned out super cute.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Cutiness is justice. Without a doubt, 
everyone's eyes will be glued to Machan 
and the others."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once the choreography for the last 
part is decided, it'll be complete... Ah.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer, hello!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's the choreography for a creative 
dance. We have a little inter-dormitory 
performance coming up soon.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. To aim for victory, Machan and 
Flight-san have formed a duo.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
As a super cute duo, we'll perform a dance 
that'll leave a huge impression on 
everyone. Right~?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I know, right?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"It'll be complete once we finalize the 
choreography for the ending, but..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
There are two options. I haven't been able 
to decide yet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"That is convenient. Let us go ask 
Flight-san's trainer."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: First—...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Spinning around... and strike a pose.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: The other one is...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Jump, and then... hit the signature pose.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer, which one do you think is better?
choice_data_list: Spin right 'round and... strike a pose!
Jump, and then... strike a pose!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ma-chan also recommends this one. 
Spinning round and round is cute, like a 
flower floating on water."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Sounds lovely! In that case, let's 
decorate the outfit with lots of little 
flowers. I'm sure it will be absolutely 
gorgeous.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! I'll make sure my 
dance is cuter and more sparkling than 
anyone else's♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them laughed happily. It looked 
like it was going to be a very light, 
graceful dance.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It certainly packs enough of an impact. It 
looks like it will be a memorable dance.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"First impressions are crucial. To nail it 
completely, we'll need plenty of lessons."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's do our best! Once it's 
finished, I want Trainer to see it too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I'm sure everyone will enjoy it♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them are fully pumped up. This 
looks like it'll be an unforgettable 
dance.
